#' @title Plot Volcano Plot with Top 5 Feature Labels
#'
#' @description
#' 绘制火山图（Volcano Plot），展示差异分析结果。火山图以logFC为X轴、
#' -log10(P value)为Y轴，每个点代表一个feature。显著差异feature用
#' 不同颜色标记，并标注Top 5差异最大的feature名称。
#'
#' 该图是组学差异分析中最常用的可视化方法，直观展示差异feature的
#' 数量、方向和显著性。
#'
#' @param dea_result 数据框，由perform_limma返回，必须包含Feature、logFC、pvalue_adj、significant列
#' @param feature_anno 数据框，feature注释信息（可选，用于显示feature name）
#' @param pvalue_threshold 数值，P值阈值，默认0.05
#' @param logfc_threshold 数值，logFC阈值，默认1
#' @param top_n 整数，标注的Top feature数，默认5
#' @param output_dir 字符串，输出目录路径
#' @param width 数值，图片宽度（英寸），默认8
#' @param height 数值，图片高度（英寸），默认7
#'
#' @return 不可见地返回ggplot对象
#'
#' @examples
#' \dontrun{
#' dea_result <- perform_limma(expr, meta, strategy = "pvalue_logFC")
#' plot_volcano(dea_result, feature_anno, top_n = 5,
#'             output_dir = "./figures")
#' }
#'
#' @export
plot_volcano <- function(dea_result, feature_anno = NULL,
                         pvalue_threshold = 0.05, logfc_threshold = 1,
                         top_n = 5, output_dir = ".", width = 8, height = 7) {
  if (!dir.exists(output_dir)) dir.create(output_dir, recursive = TRUE)

  plot_data <- dea_result
  plot_data$neg_log10_p <- -log10(plot_data$pvalue_adj)

  plot_data$direction <- "Not Significant"
  plot_data$direction[plot_data$pvalue_adj < pvalue_threshold &
                       plot_data$logFC > logfc_threshold] <- "Up"
  plot_data$direction[plot_data$pvalue_adj < pvalue_threshold &
                       plot_data$logFC < -logfc_threshold] <- "Down"

  if (!is.null(feature_anno)) {
    name_map <- setNames(feature_anno$name, feature_anno$ID)
    plot_data$Name <- name_map[plot_data$Feature]
    plot_data$Name[is.na(plot_data$Name)] <- plot_data$Feature[is.na(plot_data$Name)]
  } else {
    plot_data$Name <- plot_data$Feature
  }

  # Select top N features by significance
  sig_data <- plot_data[plot_data$direction != "Not Significant", , drop = FALSE]
  if (nrow(sig_data) > 0) {
    sig_data <- sig_data[order(-abs(sig_data$logFC * -log10(sig_data$pvalue_adj))), ]
    top_features <- head(sig_data, top_n)
  } else {
    top_features <- plot_data[order(-abs(plot_data$logFC * -log10(plot_data$pvalue_adj))), ][1:top_n, ]
  }

  p <- ggplot2::ggplot(plot_data, ggplot2::aes(x = logFC, y = neg_log10_p,
                                                color = direction)) +
    ggplot2::geom_point(alpha = 0.6, size = 1.5) +
    ggrepel::geom_text_repel(data = top_features,
                              ggplot2::aes(label = Name),
                              size = 3, max.overlaps = 20,
                              color = "black", box.padding = 0.5) +
    ggplot2::geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(pvalue_threshold),
                         linetype = "dashed", color = "grey50") +
    ggplot2::geom_vline(xintercept = c(-logfc_threshold, logfc_threshold),
                         linetype = "dashed", color = "grey50") +
    ggplot2::scale_color_manual(values = c("Up" = "#E64B35",
                                            "Down" = "#4DBBD5",
                                            "Not Significant" = "grey80")) +
    ggplot2::labs(
      title = "Volcano Plot",
      x = expression(log[2]~Fold~Change),
      y = expression(-log[10]~(adjusted~P~value)),
      color = "Direction"
    ) +
    ggplot2::theme_bw() +
    ggplot2::theme(
      plot.title = ggplot2::element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 14, face = "bold"),
      legend.position = "right"
    )

  pdf_file <- file.path(output_dir, "Volcano_plot.pdf")
  png_file <- file.path(output_dir, "Volcano_plot.png")

  grDevices::pdf(pdf_file, width = width, height = height)
  print(p)
  grDevices::dev.off()

  grDevices::png(png_file, width = width * 300, height = height * 300, res = 300)
  print(p)
  grDevices::dev.off()

  message("Volcano plot saved to:\n  ", pdf_file, "\n  ", png_file)
  invisible(p)
}


#' @title Plot Venn Diagram
#'
#' @description
#' 绘制文氏图（Venn Diagram），展示多个feature集合之间的交集与并集。
#' 文氏图常用于比较不同差异分析策略、不同比较组或不同组学之间
#' 的差异feature集合重叠情况。
#'
#' @param sets 命名列表，每个元素是一个feature ID向量
#' @param set_names 字符向量，集合名称（可选，默认使用列表名）
#' @param output_dir 字符串，输出目录路径
#' @param width 数值，图片宽度（英寸），默认7
#' @param height 数值，图片高度（英寸），默认7
#'
#' @return 不可见地返回ggplot对象
#'
#' @examples
#' \dontrun{
#' # 比较两种差异分析策略的结果
#' sets <- list(
#'   pvalue_logFC = dea_result1$Feature[dea_result1$significant],
#'   pvalue_vip = dea_result2$Feature[dea_result2$significant]
#' )
#' plot_venn(sets, output_dir = "./figures")
#' }
#'
#' @export
plot_venn <- function(sets, set_names = NULL, output_dir = ".",
                      width = 7, height = 7) {
  if (!dir.exists(output_dir)) dir.create(output_dir, recursive = TRUE)

  if (is.null(set_names)) {
    set_names <- names(sets)
    if (is.null(set_names)) set_names <- paste0("Set", seq_along(sets))
  }

  if (length(sets) > 5) {
    stop("Venn diagram supports at most 5 sets. Use plot_upset instead.")
  }

  # Use ggVennDiagram if available, otherwise fall back to VennDiagram
  if (requireNamespace("ggVennDiagram", quietly = TRUE)) {
    p <- ggVennDiagram::ggVennDiagram(sets, label = "count") +
      ggplot2::labs(title = "Venn Diagram") +
      ggplot2::theme(plot.title = ggplot2::element_text(hjust = 0.5,
                                                         size = 14,
                                                         face = "bold"))
  } else if (requireNamespace("VennDiagram", quietly = TRUE)) {
    venn_obj <- VennDiagram::venn.diagram(sets, filename = NULL,
                                           fill = RColorBrewer::brewer.pal(length(sets), "Set2"),
                                           cat.cex = 1.5,
                                           cex = 1.5)
    pdf_file <- file.path(output_dir, "Venn_diagram.pdf")
    png_file <- file.path(output_dir, "Venn_diagram.png")

    grDevices::pdf(pdf_file, width = width, height = height)
    grid::grid.draw(venn_obj)
    grDevices::dev.off()

    grDevices::png(png_file, width = width * 300, height = height * 300, res = 300)
    grid::grid.draw(venn_obj)
    grDevices::dev.off()

    message("Venn diagram saved to:\n  ", pdf_file, "\n  ", png_file)
    return(invisible(NULL))
  } else {
    stop("Please install 'ggVennDiagram' or 'VennDiagram' package.")
  }

  pdf_file <- file.path(output_dir, "Venn_diagram.pdf")
  png_file <- file.path(output_dir, "Venn_diagram.png")

  grDevices::pdf(pdf_file, width = width, height = height)
  print(p)
  grDevices::dev.off()

  grDevices::png(png_file, width = width * 300, height = height * 300, res = 300)
  print(p)
  grDevices::dev.off()

  message("Venn diagram saved to:\n  ", pdf_file, "\n  ", png_file)
  invisible(p)
}


#' @title Plot Upset Plot
#'
#' @description
#' 绘制Upset图，展示多个feature集合之间的交集关系。Upset图是文氏图
#' 的替代方案，适用于集合数较多（>5）或集合大小差异较大的情况。
#' 该图通过矩阵形式展示各组合的交集大小。
#'
#' @param sets 命名列表，每个元素是一个feature ID向量
#' @param sets_order 字符向量，集合顺序（可选）
#' @param n_intersections 整数，显示的最大交集数，默认30
#' @param output_dir 字符串，输出目录路径
#' @param width 数值，图片宽度（英寸），默认10
#' @param height 数值，图片高度（英寸），默认6
#'
#' @return 不可见地返回ggplot对象
#'
#' @examples
#' \dontrun{
#' sets <- list(
#'   Set1 = features1,
#'   Set2 = features2,
#'   Set3 = features3,
#'   Set4 = features4,
#'   Set5 = features5,
#'   Set6 = features6
#' )
#' plot_upset(sets, output_dir = "./figures")
#' }
#'
#' @export
plot_upset <- function(sets, sets_order = NULL, n_intersections = 30,
                       output_dir = ".", width = 10, height = 6) {
  if (!dir.exists(output_dir)) dir.create(output_dir, recursive = TRUE)

  if (!requireNamespace("UpSetR", quietly = TRUE)) {
    stop("Package 'UpSetR' is required. Please install it.")
  }

  # Build binary matrix
  all_features <- unique(unlist(sets))
  binary_matrix <- matrix(0, nrow = length(all_features),
                          ncol = length(sets),
                          dimnames = list(all_features, names(sets)))
  for (i in seq_along(sets)) {
    binary_matrix[sets[[i]], i] <- 1
  }

  binary_df <- as.data.frame(binary_matrix)

  pdf_file <- file.path(output_dir, "Upset_plot.pdf")
  png_file <- file.path(output_dir, "Upset_plot.png")

  p <- UpSetR::upset(binary_df, nsets = ncol(binary_df),
                     nintersects = n_intersections,
                     order.by = "freq",
                     main.bar.color = "steelblue",
                     sets.bar.color = "darkorange",
                     point.size = 3,
                     line.size = 1)

  grDevices::pdf(pdf_file, width = width, height = height)
  print(p)
  grDevices::dev.off()

  grDevices::png(png_file, width = width * 300, height = height * 300, res = 300)
  print(p)
  grDevices::dev.off()

  message("Upset plot saved to:\n  ", pdf_file, "\n  ", png_file)
  invisible(p)
}


#' @title Plot Heatmap with Hierarchical Clustering
#'
#' @description
#' 绘制热图，行一般为feature维度，列一般为样本维度。列按照样本分组
#' 做排序，feature维度行做层次聚类树。如果feature注释中存在family信息，
#' 还会使用颜色块显示feature的family分类。
#'
#' 该图用于展示feature表达模式、样本聚类关系和分组差异。
#'
#' @param expr_matrix 数值矩阵，表达矩阵
#' @param sample_meta 数据框，样本元数据
#' @param feature_anno 数据框，feature注释信息（可选，用于显示family）
#' @param scale_row 逻辑值，是否对行做Z-score标准化，默认TRUE
#' @param cluster_rows 逻辑值，是否对行做层次聚类，默认TRUE
#' @param cluster_cols 逻辑值，是否对列做层次聚类，默认FALSE（按分组排序）
#' @param show_rownames 逻辑值，是否显示行名，默认FALSE（feature数多时）
#' @param show_colnames 逻辑值，是否显示列名，默认FALSE
#' @param output_dir 字符串，输出目录路径
#' @param width 数值，图片宽度（英寸），默认10
#' @param height 数值，图片高度（英寸），默认12
#'
#' @return 不可见地返回pheatmap对象
#'
#' @examples
#' \dontrun{
#' plot_heatmap(expr, meta, feature_anno, output_dir = "./figures")
#' }
#'
#' @export
plot_heatmap <- function(expr_matrix, sample_meta, feature_anno = NULL,
                         scale_row = TRUE, cluster_rows = TRUE,
                         cluster_cols = FALSE, show_rownames = FALSE,
                         show_colnames = FALSE, output_dir = ".",
                         width = 10, height = 12) {
  if (!dir.exists(output_dir)) dir.create(output_dir, recursive = TRUE)

  if (!requireNamespace("pheatmap", quietly = TRUE)) {
    stop("Package 'pheatmap' is required. Please install it.")
  }

  # Order samples by group
  matched_meta <- sample_meta[match(colnames(expr_matrix), sample_meta$ID), ]
  group_order <- order(matched_meta$sample_info)
  expr_ordered <- expr_matrix[, group_order, drop = FALSE]
  matched_meta <- matched_meta[group_order, ]

  # Build column annotation
  col_anno <- data.frame(Group = matched_meta$sample_info,
                         row.names = matched_meta$ID)
  anno_colors <- list(Group = setNames(
    RColorBrewer::brewer.pal(nlevels(matched_meta$sample_info), "Set2")[1:nlevels(matched_meta$sample_info)],
    levels(matched_meta$sample_info)
  ))

  # Build row annotation (family)
  row_anno <- NULL
  row_anno_colors <- NULL
  if (!is.null(feature_anno) && "family" %in% colnames(feature_anno)) {
    family_map <- setNames(feature_anno$family, feature_anno$ID)
    families <- family_map[rownames(expr_ordered)]
    families[is.na(families)] <- "Unknown"
    row_anno <- data.frame(Family = factor(families),
                          row.names = rownames(expr_ordered))
    n_families <- min(length(unique(families)), 12)
    row_anno_colors <- list(Family = setNames(
      c(RColorBrewer::brewer.pal(n_families, "Set3"), "grey80")[1:length(unique(families))],
      levels(factor(families))
    ))
  }

  # Scaling
  plot_data <- expr_ordered
  if (scale_row) {
    plot_data <- t(scale(t(plot_data)))
  }

  pdf_file <- file.path(output_dir, "Heatmap.pdf")
  png_file <- file.path(output_dir, "Heatmap.png")

  # PDF
  grDevices::pdf(pdf_file, width = width, height = height)
  p <- pheatmap::pheatmap(plot_data,
                          cluster_rows = cluster_rows,
                          cluster_cols = cluster_cols,
                          annotation_col = col_anno,
                          annotation_row = row_anno,
                          annotation_colors = c(anno_colors, row_anno_colors),
                          show_rownames = show_rownames,
                          show_colnames = show_colnames,
                          color = colorRampPalette(c("blue", "white", "red"))(100),
                          fontsize_row = 8,
                          fontsize_col = 8,
                          border_color = NA,
                          scale = ifelse(scale_row, "row", "none"))
  grDevices::dev.off()

  # PNG
  grDevices::png(png_file, width = width * 300, height = height * 300, res = 300)
  p <- pheatmap::pheatmap(plot_data,
                          cluster_rows = cluster_rows,
                          cluster_cols = cluster_cols,
                          annotation_col = col_anno,
                          annotation_row = row_anno,
                          annotation_colors = c(anno_colors, row_anno_colors),
                          show_rownames = show_rownames,
                          show_colnames = show_colnames,
                          color = colorRampPalette(c("blue", "white", "red"))(100),
                          fontsize_row = 8,
                          fontsize_col = 8,
                          border_color = NA,
                          scale = ifelse(scale_row, "row", "none"))
  grDevices::dev.off()

  message("Heatmap saved to:\n  ", pdf_file, "\n  ", png_file)
  invisible(p)
}

print(table(sample_meta_all$sample_info))

names(metab_anno)[1] <- "ID"

# Extract needed annotation fields
# The metabolites.csv has: name, class, sub_class, super_class, kegg_class, kegg_category etc.
anno_fields <- c("ID", "name")
if ("class" %in% colnames(metab_anno)) anno_fields <- c(anno_fields, "class")

if ("super_class" %in% colnames(metab_anno)) anno_fields <- c(anno_fields, "super_class")
if ("kegg_class" %in% colnames(metab_anno)) anno_fields <- c(anno_fields, "kegg_class")
if ("kegg_category" %in% colnames(metab_anno)) anno_fields <- c(anno_fields, "kegg_category")
if ("category" %in% colnames(metab_anno)) anno_fields <- c(anno_fields, "category")

for (d in design_list) {

}

#3e. Filter out QC samples - keep only biological samples present in expr matrix

} else if ("kegg_category" %in% colnames(feature_anno)) {

} else {

}

cat(" Data loading complete.\n\n")

# ===========================================================================
#4. Multi-factor ANOVA (Single factor: group)
# ===========================================================================
cat("[4/8] Performing multi-factor ANOVA...\n")

# Since we have only one factor (group), we add a dummy second factor to
# demonstrate the multifactor capability. But the actual analysis uses
# single-factor ANOVA for the group variable.
# We'll run the single-factor ANOVA properly using the perform_ftest approach
# for the overall test, and use our custom single-factor for the detailed table.

# Manual single-factor ANOVA for each metabolite
group_vector <- sample_meta$sample_info[match(colnames(expr_raw), sample_meta$ID)]

anova_list <- apply(expr_raw,1, function(row_vals) {
 df <- data.frame(value = as.numeric(row_vals), group = group_vector)
 fit <- aov(value ~ group, data = df)
 s <- summary(fit)[[1]]
 c(F_stat = s$`F value`[1],
 df_group = s$Df[1],
 df_resid = s$Df[2],
 pvalue = s$`Pr(>F)`[1])
})

anova_result <- data.frame(
 Feature = rownames(expr_raw),
 F_statistic = anova_list["F_stat", ],
 Df_group = anova_list["df_group", ],
 Df_residual = anova_list["df_resid", ],
 pvalue = anova_list["pvalue", ],
 stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)
anova_result$pvalue_adj <- p.adjust(anova_result$pvalue, method = "BH")

# Add annotation
anova_result$name <- name_map[anova_result$Feature]
anova_result$name[is.na(anova_result$name)] <- anova_result$Feature[is.na(anova_result$name)]

write.csv(anova_result, OUT_ANOVA, row.names = FALSE)
cat(" ANOVA results saved to:", basename(OUT_ANOVA), "\n")
cat(" Significant (FDR <0.05):", sum(anova_result$pvalue_adj <0.05, na.rm = TRUE), "features\n\n")

# ===========================================================================
#5. Overall F-test using limma
# ===========================================================================
cat("[5/8] Performing overall F-test (limma)...\n")

# Build design matrix for all3 groups
design_all <- model.matrix(~0 + group_vector)
colnames(design_all) <- levels(group_vector)

# Fit limma model
fit_all <- lmFit(expr_raw, design_all)

# Test for any differences among groups (overall F-test)
# Contrast: test if any group mean differs from others
# For3 groups, we can test all pairwise or use the overall F-test
# Using eBayes without contrasts gives an overall F-test
fit_all <- eBayes(fit_all)

# Extract F-test results
ftest_top <- topTable(fit_all, number = Inf, sort.by = "F", 
 adjust.method = "BH")
ftest_result <- data.frame(
 Feature = rownames(ftest_top),
 F_statistic = ftest_top$F,
 pvalue = ftest_top$P.Value,
 pvalue_adj = ftest_top$adj.P.Val,
 stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)
ftest_result$name <- name_map[ftest_result$Feature]
ftest_result$name[is.na(ftest_result$name)] <- ftest_result$Feature[is.na(ftest_result$name)]

write.csv(ftest_result, OUT_FTEST, row.names = FALSE)
cat(" Overall F-test results saved to:", basename(OUT_FTEST), "\n")
cat(" Significant (FDR <0.05):", sum(ftest_result$pvalue_adj <0.05, na.rm = TRUE), "features\n\n")

# ===========================================================================
#6. Pairwise LIMMA Differential Analysis with VIP filtering
# ===========================================================================
cat("[6/8] Performing pairwise LIMMA differential analysis...\n")

# Define group labels for clarity
GROUP_CD <- "Clostridium difficile infection"
GROUP_FE <- "high iron diet before"
GROUP_NC <- "Standard (control)"

# Define comparisons - mapping comparison name to (treatment, control)
comparisons <- list(
 list(name = "FE_vs_CD", treatment = GROUP_FE, control = GROUP_CD,
 file = OUT_FE_VS_CD, fig_prefix = "FE_vs_CD",
 title = "FE (High-Iron Diet + CDI) vs CD (CDI only)"),
 list(name = "CD_vs_NC", treatment = GROUP_CD, control = GROUP_NC,
 file = OUT_CD_VS_NC, fig_prefix = "CD_vs_NC",
 title = "CD (CDI only) vs NC (Healthy Control)"),
 list(name = "FE_vs_NC", treatment = GROUP_FE, control = GROUP_NC,
 file = OUT_FE_VS_NC, fig_prefix = "FE_vs_NC",
 title = "FE (High-Iron Diet + CDI) vs NC (Healthy Control)")
)

# Store all differential metabolite lists for Venn diagram
all_de_lists <- list()
# Store full results for consolidation
all_results <- list()

for (comp in comparisons) {
 comp_name <- comp$name
 treatment_grp <- comp$treatment
 control_grp <- comp$control
  
 cat(" --- Comparison:", comp_name, "(", treatment_grp, "vs", control_grp, ") ---\n")
  
 # Subset samples for this comparison
 comp_samples <- sample_meta$ID[sample_meta$sample_info %in% c(treatment_grp, control_grp)]
 comp_expr <- expr_raw[, comp_samples, drop = FALSE]
 comp_meta <- sample_meta[sample_meta$ID %in% comp_samples, , drop = FALSE]
  
 # Ensure order consistency
 comp_meta <- comp_meta[match(colnames(comp_expr), comp_meta$ID), ]
 comp_meta$sample_info <- droplevels(comp_meta$sample_info)
  
 cat(" Samples:", ncol(comp_expr), "(", 
 sum(comp_meta$sample_info == treatment_grp), treatment_grp, "+",
 sum(comp_meta$sample_info == control_grp), control_grp, ")\n")
  
 # ----6a. LIMMA analysis ----
 # Build design matrix
 groups_comp <- comp_meta$sample_info
 design_comp <- model.matrix(~0 + groups_comp)
 colnames(design_comp) <- levels(groups_comp)
  
 # Contrast: treatment - control
 contrast_str <- paste0(treatment_grp, " - ", control_grp)
 contrast_mat <- makeContrasts(contrasts = contrast_str, levels = design_comp)
  
 # Fit
 fit_comp <- lmFit(comp_expr, design_comp)
 fit_comp <- contrasts.fit(fit_comp, contrast_mat)
 fit_comp <- eBayes(fit_comp)
  
 # Extract results
 tt <- topTable(fit_comp, number = Inf, adjust.method = "BH", sort.by = "none")
  
 result_df <- data.frame(
 Feature = rownames(tt),
 logFC = tt$logFC,
 pvalue = tt$P.Value,
 pvalue_adj = tt$adj.P.Val,
 stringsAsFactors = FALSE
 )
  
 # ----6b. PLS-DA for VIP values ----
 cat(" Computing VIP values via PLS-DA...\n")
  
 # For PLS-DA, we only need the two-group subset
 # Use mixOmics::plsda
 X <- t(comp_expr)
 Y <- comp_meta$sample_info
  
 # Scale X
 plsda_fit <- mixOmics::plsda(X, Y, ncomp =2, scale = TRUE, center = TRUE)
 vip_matrix <- mixOmics::vip(plsda_fit)
  
 # Extract Comp1 VIP values
 vip_values <- vip_matrix[,1]
 names(vip_values) <- rownames(comp_expr)
  
 result_df$VIP <- vip_values[result_df$Feature]
  
 # ----6c. Apply filtering: pvalue_adj <0.05 → VIP >1 → top500 by |logFC| ----
 cat(" Applying filters: p.adj <0.05, VIP >1, top500 by |logFC|\n")
  
 # Step1: pvalue_adj <0.05
 sig_p <- result_df$pvalue_adj <0.05 & !is.na(result_df$pvalue_adj)
 cat(" After p.adj <0.05:", sum(sig_p, na.rm = TRUE), "features\n")
  
 # Step2: VIP >1 (among those with p.adj <0.05)
 sig_vip <- sig_p & !is.na(result_df$VIP) & result_df$VIP >1
 cat(" After VIP >1:", sum(sig_vip, na.rm = TRUE), "features\n")
  
 # Step3: Sort by |logFC| descending, take top500
 sig_idx <- which(sig_vip)
 if (length(sig_idx) >0) {
 sig_ordered <- sig_idx[order(-abs(result_df$logFC[sig_idx]))]
 top_idx <- sig_ordered[1:min(500, length(sig_ordered))]
 } else {
 top_idx <- integer(0)
 }
  
 # Mark significant
 result_df$significant <- FALSE
 result_df$significant[top_idx] <- TRUE
  
 # Add direction
 result_df$direction <- "Not Significant"
 result_df$direction[result_df$significant & result_df$logFC >0] <- "Up"
 result_df$direction[result_df$significant & result_df$logFC <0] <- "Down"
  
 # Add metabolite name
 result_df$name <- name_map[result_df$Feature]
 result_df$name[is.na(result_df$name)] <- result_df$Feature[is.na(result_df$name)]
  
 # Add class/category for downstream
 result_df$class <- class_map[result_df$Feature]
 result_df$class[is.na(result_df$class)] <- "Unknown"
  
 cat(" Final significant (top500):", sum(result_df$significant), "features\n")
 cat(" Up:", sum(result_df$direction == "Up"), "\n")
 cat(" Down:", sum(result_df$direction == "Down"), "\n")
  
 # Save result
 write.csv(result_df, comp$file, row.names = FALSE)
 cat(" Saved to:", basename(comp$file), "\n")
  
 # Store for later use
 all_results[[comp_name]] <- result_df
 sig_features <- result_df$Feature[result_df$significant]
 all_de_lists[[comp_name]] <- sig_features
  
 cat("\n")
}

# ----6d. Consolidate all comparison results ----
cat(" Consolidating all comparison results...\n")

# Merge results from all comparisons into one table

}

 # Prepare plot data

 # Top5 features to label (by -log10(p) * |logFC|)
 sig_idx <- which(plot_data$significant)
 if (length(sig_idx) >0) {
 plot_data$score <- abs(plot_data$logFC) * plot_data$neg_log10_p
 top5_idx <- sig_idx[order(-plot_data$score[sig_idx])]
 top5_idx <- head(top5_idx,5)
 } else {
 top5_idx <- integer(0)
 }
  
 # Counts

 ) +

 labs(

 color = "Regulation"
 ) +
 theme_bw(base_size =12) +
 theme(
 plot.title = element_text(hjust =0.5, size =14, face = "bold"),
 plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust =0.5, size =10, color = "grey40"),
 legend.position = "right",
 panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
 )
  
 # Add top5 labels
 if (length(top5_idx) >0) {
 p <- p + geom_text_repel(

 size =3.2,
 max.overlaps =15,
 color = "black",
 box.padding =0.5,
 point.padding =0.3,
 fontface = "italic",
 segment.color = "grey50",
 segment.size =0.3
 )
 }

 png_file <- file.path(FIGURES_DIR, paste0("Volcano_", comp$fig_prefix, ".png"))
  
 pdf(pdf_file, width =9, height =7)

 png(png_file, width =2700, height =2100, res =300)
 print(p)

FunctionArguments.content:
# =============================================================================
# Module4: LIMMA Differential Analysis
# Description: Perform differential expression analysis using LIMMA,
# multifactor ANOVA, overall F-test, PLS-DA VIP calculation, and
# publication-grade visualizations.
#
# Study: High-iron diet modulates Clostridioides difficile infection (CDI)
# susceptibility through gut microbiota and metabolic remodeling.
#
# Groups: CD = Clostridium difficile infection (n=6)
# FE = high iron diet before (n=6)
# NC = Standard (control) (n=6)
# Comparisons: FE_vs_CD, CD_vs_NC, FE_vs_NC
# =============================================================================

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
#0. Configuration - Directory and File Paths
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
WORK_DIR <- "G:/OmicsWorks/test/metabolism/demo/tmp/4_limma_differential_analysis"
SCRIPT_DIR <- file.path(WORK_DIR, "scripts")
TABLES_DIR <- file.path(WORK_DIR, "tables")
FIGURES_DIR <- "G:/OmicsWorks/test/metabolism/demo/analysis/4_limma_differential_analysis/figures"
AGENT_RSCRIPT <- "G:/OmicsWorks/agent/rscript"

# Input files
PREPROCESSED_EXPR <- "G:/OmicsWorks/test/metabolism/demo/tmp/preprocessed_expression.csv"
SAMPLE_INFO <- "G:/OmicsWorks/test/metabolism/sampleinfo.csv"
DESIGN_JSON <- "G:/OmicsWorks/test/metabolism/demo/analysis/design.json"
METABOLITES_ANNO <- "G:/OmicsWorks/test/metabolism/metabolites.csv"

# Output files
OUT_ANOVA <- file.path(TABLES_DIR, "limma_multifactor_anova.csv")
OUT_FTEST <- file.path(TABLES_DIR, "limma_overall_ftest.csv")
OUT_FE_VS_CD <- file.path(TABLES_DIR, "limma_FE_vs_CD.csv")
OUT_CD_VS_NC <- file.path(TABLES_DIR, "limma_CD_vs_NC.csv")
OUT_FE_VS_NC <- file.path(TABLES_DIR, "limma_FE_vs_NC.csv")
OUT_CONSOLIDATED <- file.path(TABLES_DIR, "limma_all_comparisons_consolidated.csv")

# Create output directories
dir.create(TABLES_DIR, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(FIGURES_DIR, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
#1. Package Installation / Loading
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
cat("=================================================================\n")
cat("Module4: LIMMA Differential Analysis\n")
cat("=================================================================\n\n")
cat("[1/8] Installing/loading required R packages...\n")

cran_pkgs <- c("ggplot2", "ggrepel", "ggVennDiagram", "pheatmap",
 "RColorBrewer", "UpSetR", "jsonlite")
for (pkg in cran_pkgs) {
 if (!requireNamespace(pkg, quietly = TRUE)) {
 install.packages(pkg, repos = "https://cloud.r-project.org", quiet = TRUE)
 }
 library(pkg, character.only = TRUE)
}

bio_pkgs <- c("limma", "mixOmics")
for (pkg in bio_pkgs) {
 if (!requireNamespace(pkg, quietly = TRUE)) {
 if (!requireNamespace("BiocManager", quietly = TRUE)) {
 install.packages("BiocManager", repos = "https://cloud.r-project.org", quiet = TRUE)
 }
 BiocManager::install(pkg, ask = FALSE, update = FALSE, quiet = TRUE)
 }
 library(pkg, character.only = TRUE)
}

library(grDevices)
library(stats)

cat(" All packages loaded successfully.\n\n")

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
#2. Source helper functions
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
cat("[2/8] Loading helper functions from agent library...\n")
source(file.path(AGENT_RSCRIPT, "data_io.R"))
source(file.path(AGENT_RSCRIPT, "differential.R"))
source(file.path(AGENT_RSCRIPT, "multivariate.R"))
source(file.path(AGENT_RSCRIPT, "visualization.R"))
cat(" Helper functions loaded.\n\n")

# ===========================================================================
#3. Data Loading and Validation
# ===========================================================================
cat("[3/8] Loading input data...\n")

#3a. Expression matrix
cat(" Loading expression matrix from:", basename(PREPROCESSED_EXPR), "\n")
expr_raw <- load_expression_matrix(PREPROCESSED_EXPR)
cat(" Dimensions:", nrow(expr_raw), "metabolites x", ncol(expr_raw), "samples\n")

#3b. Sample metadata
cat(" Loading sample metadata from:", basename(SAMPLE_INFO), "\n")
sample_meta_all <- load_sample_metadata(SAMPLE_INFO)
cat(" Total samples:", nrow(sample_meta_all), "\n")
print(table(sample_meta_all$sample_info))

#3c. Metabolite annotation
cat(" Loading metabolite annotation from:", basename(METABOLITES_ANNO), "\n")
metab_anno <- read.csv(METABOLITES_ANNO, stringsAsFactors = FALSE, check.names = FALSE)
cat(" Annotation rows:", nrow(metab_anno), "\n")

# Rename first column to ID
colnames(metab_anno)[1] <- "ID"
metab_anno$ID <- as.character(metab_anno$ID)

# The expression matrix rownames are compound names (like "Tandutinib")
# The metabolites.csv "name" column has matching names
# So we match expr rownames -> metab_anno$name
expr_feature_names <- rownames(expr_raw)
name_to_anno <- metab_anno[match(expr_feature_names, metab_anno$name), , drop = FALSE]
rownames(name_to_anno) <- expr_feature_names

cat(" Match rate:", sum(!is.na(name_to_anno$ID)), "/", nrow(expr_raw), "\n")

# Build annotation maps
name_map <- setNames(name_to_anno$name, expr_feature_names)
name_map[is.na(name_map)] <- expr_feature_names[is.na(name_map)]

# Use class for heatmap annotation (or kegg_category as fallback)
if ("class" %in% colnames(metab_anno)) {
 class_map <- setNames(name_to_anno$class, expr_feature_names)
} else if ("kegg_category" %in% colnames(metab_anno)) {
 class_map <- setNames(name_to_anno$kegg_category, expr_feature_names)
} else {
 class_map <- setNames(rep("Unknown", nrow(expr_raw)), expr_feature_names)
}
class_map[is.na(class_map)] <- "Unknown"

# Also build kegg pathway map for downstream
kegg_map <- NULL
if ("kegg" %in% colnames(metab_anno)) {
 kegg_map <- setNames(name_to_anno$kegg, expr_feature_names)
}

#3d. Comparison design
cat(" Loading comparison design from:", basename(DESIGN_JSON), "\n")
design_list <- jsonlite::fromJSON(DESIGN_JSON, simplifyVector = FALSE)
cat(" Number of comparisons:", length(design_list), "\n")
for (d in design_list) {
 cat(" -", d$name, ":", d$treatment, "vs", d$control, "\n")
}

#3e. Filter out QC samples - keep only biological samples
bio_samples <- intersect(colnames(expr_raw), sample_meta_all$ID)
expr_raw <- expr_raw[, bio_samples, drop = FALSE]
sample_meta <- sample_meta_all[sample_meta_all$ID %in% bio_samples, , drop = FALSE]
sample_meta <- sample_meta[match(colnames(expr_raw), sample_meta$ID), , drop = FALSE]
rownames(sample_meta) <- NULL

# CRITICAL: Drop unused factor levels (QC group is a level but has no samples now)
sample_meta$sample_info <- droplevels(sample_meta$sample_info)

cat(" Biological samples retained:", ncol(expr_raw), "\n")
cat(" Groups:", paste(levels(sample_meta$sample_info), collapse = ", "), "\n")
print(table(sample_meta$sample_info))

cat(" Data loading complete.\n\n")

# ===========================================================================
#4. Multi-factor ANOVA (Single factor: group)
# ===========================================================================
cat("[4/8] Performing single-factor ANOVA...\n")

group_vector <- sample_meta$sample_info[match(colnames(expr_raw), sample_meta$ID)]

anova_list <- apply(expr_raw,1, function(row_vals) {
 df <- data.frame(value = as.numeric(row_vals), group = group_vector)
 fit <- aov(value ~ group, data = df)
 s <- summary(fit)[[1]]
 c(F_stat = s$`F value`[1],
 df_group = s$Df[1],
 df_resid = s$Df[2],
 pvalue = s$`Pr(>F)`[1])
})

anova_result <- data.frame(
 Feature = rownames(expr_raw),
 name = name_map[rownames(expr_raw)],
 F_statistic = anova_list["F_stat", ],
 Df_group = anova_list["df_group", ],
 Df_residual = anova_list["df_resid", ],
 pvalue = anova_list["pvalue", ],
 stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)
anova_result$pvalue_adj <- p.adjust(anova_result$pvalue, method = "BH")

write.csv(anova_result, OUT_ANOVA, row.names = FALSE)
cat(" ANOVA results saved to:", basename(OUT_ANOVA), "\n")
cat(" Significant (FDR <0.05):", sum(anova_result$pvalue_adj <0.05, na.rm = TRUE), "features\n\n")

# ===========================================================================
#5. Overall F-test using limma (direct approach)
# ===========================================================================
cat("[5/8] Performing overall F-test (limma)...\n")

# Design matrix with all3 groups (QC already excluded)
design_all <- model.matrix(~0 + group_vector)
colnames(design_all) <- levels(group_vector)

# Check that design is full rank
cat(" Design matrix rank:", qr(design_all)$rank, "vs", ncol(design_all), "columns\n")

if (qr(design_all)$rank >= ncol(design_all)) {
 fit_all <- lmFit(expr_raw, design_all)
  
 # Test all group means =0 (overall F-test)
 # Use the "group means" approach: test if any group deviates
 # We create a contrast matrix for all pairwise differences
 if (ncol(design_all) ==3) {
 # For3 groups: test if group1=group2, group1=group3 simultaneously
 cm <- makeContrasts(
 CD_vs_NC = "Clostridium difficile infection - Standard (control)",
 FE_vs_NC = "high iron diet before - Standard (control)",
 levels = design_all
 )
 fit_all <- contrasts.fit(fit_all, cm)
 }
  
 fit_all <- eBayes(fit_all)
  
 # Get F-test result
 ftest_top <- topTable(fit_all, number = Inf, sort.by = "F", adjust.method = "BH")
  
 ftest_result <- data.frame(
 Feature = rownames(ftest_top),
 name = name_map[rownames(ftest_top)],
 F_statistic = ftest_top$F,
 pvalue = ftest_top$P.Value,
 pvalue_adj = ftest_top$adj.P.Val,
 stringsAsFactors = FALSE
 )
} else {
 cat(" Design matrix not full rank. Computing ANOVA-style F-test instead.\n")
 # Fallback to aov-based F-test (already computed in step4)
 ftest_result <- anova_result[, c("Feature", "name", "F_statistic", "pvalue", "pvalue_adj")]
 colnames(ftest_result)[3] <- "F_statistic"
}

write.csv(ftest_result, OUT_FTEST, row.names = FALSE)
cat(" Overall F-test results saved to:", basename(OUT_FTEST), "\n")
cat(" Significant (FDR <0.05):", sum(ftest_result$pvalue_adj <0.05, na.rm = TRUE), "features\n\n")

# ===========================================================================
#6. Pairwise LIMMA Differential Analysis with VIP filtering
# ===========================================================================
cat("[6/8] Performing pairwise LIMMA differential analysis...\n")

GROUP_CD <- "Clostridium difficile infection"
GROUP_FE <- "high iron diet before"
GROUP_NC <- "Standard (control)"

comparisons <- list(
 list(name = "FE_vs_CD", treatment = GROUP_FE, control = GROUP_CD,
 file = OUT_FE_VS_CD, fig_prefix = "FE_vs_CD",
 title = "FE (High-Iron Diet + CDI) vs CD (CDI only)"),
 list(name = "CD_vs_NC", treatment = GROUP_CD, control = GROUP_NC,
 file = OUT_CD_VS_NC, fig_prefix = "CD_vs_NC",
 title = "CD (CDI only) vs NC (Healthy Control)"),
 list(name = "FE_vs_NC", treatment = GROUP_FE, control = GROUP_NC,
 file = OUT_FE_VS_NC, fig_prefix = "FE_vs_NC",
 title = "FE (High-Iron Diet + CDI) vs NC (Healthy Control)")
)

all_de_lists <- list()
all_results <- list()

for (comp in comparisons) {
 comp_name <- comp$name
 treatment_grp <- comp$treatment
 control_grp <- comp$control
  
 cat(" --- Comparison:", comp_name, "(", treatment_grp, "vs", control_grp, ") ---\n")
  
 # Subset samples for this comparison
 comp_samples <- sample_meta$ID[sample_meta$sample_info %in% c(treatment_grp, control_grp)]
 comp_expr <- expr_raw[, comp_samples, drop = FALSE]
 comp_meta <- sample_meta[sample_meta$ID %in% comp_samples, , drop = FALSE]
 comp_meta <- comp_meta[match(colnames(comp_expr), comp_meta$ID), ]
 comp_meta$sample_info <- droplevels(comp_meta$sample_info)
  
 n_treat <- sum(comp_meta$sample_info == treatment_grp)
 n_ctrl <- sum(comp_meta$sample_info == control_grp)
 cat(" Samples:", ncol(comp_expr), "(", n_treat, treatment_grp, "+", n_ctrl, control_grp, ")\n")
  
 # ----6a. LIMMA analysis ----
 groups_comp <- comp_meta$sample_info
 design_comp <- model.matrix(~0 + groups_comp)
 colnames(design_comp) <- levels(groups_comp)
  
 contrast_str <- paste0(treatment_grp, " - ", control_grp)
 contrast_mat <- makeContrasts(contrasts = contrast_str, levels = design_comp)
  
 fit_comp <- lmFit(comp_expr, design_comp)
 fit_comp <- contrasts.fit(fit_comp, contrast_mat)
 fit_comp <- eBayes(fit_comp)
  
 tt <- topTable(fit_comp, number = Inf, adjust.method = "BH", sort.by = "none")
  
 result_df <- data.frame(
 Feature = rownames(tt),
 logFC = tt$logFC,
 pvalue = tt$P.Value,
 pvalue_adj = tt$adj.P.Val,
 stringsAsFactors = FALSE
 )
  
 # ----6b. PLS-DA for VIP values ----
 cat(" Computing VIP values via PLS-DA...\n")
  
 X <- t(comp_expr)
 Y <- comp_meta$sample_info
  
 plsda_fit <- mixOmics::plsda(X, Y, ncomp =2, scale = TRUE, center = TRUE)
 vip_matrix <- mixOmics::vip(plsda_fit)
 vip_values <- vip_matrix[,1]
 names(vip_values) <- rownames(comp_expr)
  
 result_df$VIP <- vip_values[result_df$Feature]
  
 # ----6c. Apply filtering ----
 cat(" Applying filters: p.adj <0.05, VIP >1, top500 by |logFC|\n")
  
 sig_p <- result_df$pvalue_adj <0.05 & !is.na(result_df$pvalue_adj)
 cat(" After p.adj <0.05:", sum(sig_p, na.rm = TRUE), "features\n")
  
 sig_vip <- sig_p & !is.na(result_df$VIP) & result_df$VIP >1
 cat(" After VIP >1:", sum(sig_vip, na.rm = TRUE), "features\n")
  
 sig_idx <- which(sig_vip)
 if (length(sig_idx) >0) {
 sig_ordered <- sig_idx[order(-abs(result_df$logFC[sig_idx]))]
 top_idx <- sig_ordered[1:min(500, length(sig_ordered))]
 } else {
 top_idx <- integer(0)
 }
  
 result_df$significant <- FALSE
 result_df$significant[top_idx] <- TRUE
  
 result_df$direction <- "Not Significant"
 result_df$direction[result_df$significant & result_df$logFC >0] <- "Up"
 result_df$direction[result_df$significant & result_df$logFC <0] <- "Down"
  
 # Add annotation
 result_df$name <- name_map[result_df$Feature]
 result_df$class <- class_map[result_df$Feature]
  
 cat(" Final significant (top500):", sum(result_df$significant), "features\n")
 cat(" Up:", sum(result_df$direction == "Up"), "\n")
 cat(" Down:", sum(result_df$direction == "Down"), "\n")
  
 write.csv(result_df, comp$file, row.names = FALSE)
 cat(" Saved to:", basename(comp$file), "\n")
  
 all_results[[comp_name]] <- result_df
 all_de_lists[[comp_name]] <- result_df$Feature[result_df$significant]
  
 cat("\n")
}

# ----6d. Consolidate ----
cat(" Consolidating all comparison results...\n")

all_features <- rownames(expr_raw)
consolidated <- data.frame(Feature = all_features, name = name_map[all_features],
 stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

for (comp in comparisons) {
 comp_name <- comp$name
 res <- all_results[[comp_name]]
  
 merged <- merge(consolidated,
 res[, c("Feature", "logFC", "pvalue_adj", "VIP", "significant", "direction")],

 colnames(merged)[colnames(merged) == "logFC"] <- paste0("logFC_", comp_name)
 colnames(merged)[colnames(merged) == "pvalue_adj"] <- paste0("pvalue_adj_", comp_name)
 colnames(merged)[colnames(merged) == "VIP"] <- paste0("VIP_", comp_name)
 colnames(merged)[colnames(merged) == "significant"] <- paste0("significant_", comp_name)
 colnames(merged)[colnames(merged) == "direction"] <- paste0("direction_", comp_name)
  
 consolidated <- merged
}

sig_cols <- grep("^significant_", colnames(consolidated))
consolidated$n_significant <- rowSums(consolidated[, sig_cols, drop = FALSE], na.rm = TRUE)

write.csv(consolidated, OUT_CONSOLIDATED, row.names = FALSE)
cat(" Consolidated results saved to:", basename(OUT_CONSOLIDATED), "\n")
cat(" Features significant in >=1 comparison:", sum(consolidated$n_significant >0), "\n\n")

 plot_data <- result_df

 plot_data$color_group <- "Not Significant"
 plot_data$color_group[plot_data$direction == "Up"] <- "Up"
 plot_data$color_group[plot_data$direction == "Down"] <- "Down"
 plot_data$color_group <- factor(plot_data$color_group,
 levels = c("Up", "Down", "Not Significant"))
  
 # Top5 for labeling
 sig_idx <- which(plot_data$significant)
 if (length(sig_idx) >0) {

 top5_idx <- sig_idx[order(-plot_data$score[sig_idx])]
 top5_idx <- head(top5_idx,5)
 } else {
 top5_idx <- integer(0)
 }
  
 n_up <- sum(plot_data$direction == "Up", na.rm = TRUE)
 n_down <- sum(plot_data$direction == "Down", na.rm = TRUE)
  
 p <- ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = logFC, y = neg_log10_p, color = color_group)) +
 geom_point(alpha =0.6, size =1.5) +
 scale_color_manual(

 ) +
 geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(0.05), linetype = "dashed",

 labs(title = comp$title,

source(file.path(AGENT_RSCRIPT, "visualization.R"))
cat(" Helper functions loaded.\n\n")

# ===========================================================================
#3. Data Loading and Validation
# ===========================================================================
cat("[3/8] Loading input data...\n")

expr_raw <- load_expression_matrix(PREPROCESSED_EXPR)
cat(" Expression:", nrow(expr_raw), "x", ncol(expr_raw), "\n")

sample_meta_all <- load_sample_metadata(SAMPLE_INFO)

metab_anno <- read.csv(METABOLITES_ANNO, stringsAsFactors = FALSE, check.names = FALSE)
colnames(metab_anno)[1] <- "ID"
metab_anno$ID <- as.character(metab_anno$ID)

# Match by compound name (expression rownames = compound names)
name_to_anno <- metab_anno[match(rownames(expr_raw), metab_anno$name), , drop = FALSE]
rownames(name_to_anno) <- rownames(expr_raw)
cat(" Annotation match rate:", sum(!is.na(name_to_anno$ID)), "/", nrow(expr_raw), "\n")

name_map <- setNames(name_to_anno$name, rownames(expr_raw))
name_map[is.na(name_map)] <- rownames(expr_raw)[is.na(name_map)]

if ("class" %in% colnames(metab_anno)) {
 class_map <- setNames(name_to_anno$class, rownames(expr_raw))
} else if ("kegg_category" %in% colnames(metab_anno)) {
 class_map <- setNames(name_to_anno$kegg_category, rownames(expr_raw))
} else {
 class_map <- setNames(rep("Unknown", nrow(expr_raw)), rownames(expr_raw))
}
class_map[is.na(class_map)] <- "Unknown"

# Comparison design
design_list <- jsonlite::fromJSON(DESIGN_JSON, simplifyVector = FALSE)
cat(" Comparisons:", length(design_list), "\n")
for (d in design_list) cat(" -", d$name, ":", d$treatment, "vs", d$control, "\n")

# Filter QC, drop unused levels
bio_samples <- intersect(colnames(expr_raw), sample_meta_all$ID)
expr_raw <- expr_raw[, bio_samples, drop = FALSE]
sample_meta <- sample_meta_all[sample_meta_all$ID %in% bio_samples, , drop = FALSE]
sample_meta <- sample_meta[match(colnames(expr_raw), sample_meta$ID), , drop = FALSE]
rownames(sample_meta) <- NULL
sample_meta$sample_info <- droplevels(sample_meta$sample_info)

cat(" Biological samples:", ncol(expr_raw), "\n")
cat(" Groups:", paste(levels(sample_meta$sample_info), collapse = ", "), "\n")
print(table(sample_meta$sample_info))
cat(" Data loading complete.\n\n")

# ===========================================================================
#4. Single-factor ANOVA
# ===========================================================================
cat("[4/8] Performing single-factor ANOVA...\n")

group_vector <- sample_meta$sample_info[match(colnames(expr_raw), sample_meta$ID)]

anova_list <- apply(expr_raw,1, function(row_vals) {
 df <- data.frame(value = as.numeric(row_vals), group = group_vector)
 fit <- aov(value ~ group, data = df)
 s <- summary(fit)[[1]]
 c(F_stat = s$`F value`[1], df_group = s$Df[1], df_resid = s$Df[2], pvalue = s$`Pr(>F)`[1])
})

anova_result <- data.frame(
 Feature = rownames(expr_raw), name = name_map[rownames(expr_raw)],
 F_statistic = anova_list["F_stat", ], Df_group = anova_list["df_group", ],
 Df_residual = anova_list["df_resid", ], pvalue = anova_list["pvalue", ],
 stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)
anova_result$pvalue_adj <- p.adjust(anova_result$pvalue, method = "BH")
write.csv(anova_result, OUT_ANOVA, row.names = FALSE)
cat(" ANOVA:", basename(OUT_ANOVA), "| Sig:", sum(anova_result$pvalue_adj <0.05, na.rm=TRUE), "\n\n")

# ===========================================================================
#5. Overall F-test using limma
# ===========================================================================
cat("[5/8] Performing overall F-test (limma)...\n")

# Fix: use make.names to create valid column names
design_all <- model.matrix(~0 + group_vector)
valid_grp_names <- make.names(levels(group_vector))
colnames(design_all) <- valid_grp_names

cat(" Design matrix rank:", qr(design_all)$rank, "vs", ncol(design_all), "\n")

# Use makeContrasts with valid names
cm_str <- paste0(valid_grp_names[2], " - ", valid_grp_names[1], ",",
 valid_grp_names[3], " - ", valid_grp_names[1])
cm <- eval(parse(text = paste0("makeContrasts(", cm_str, ", levels=design_all)")))

fit_all <- lmFit(expr_raw, design_all)
fit_all <- contrasts.fit(fit_all, cm)
fit_all <- eBayes(fit_all)
ftest_top <- topTable(fit_all, number = Inf, sort.by = "F", adjust.method = "BH")

ftest_result <- data.frame(
 Feature = rownames(ftest_top), name = name_map[rownames(ftest_top)],
 F_statistic = ftest_top$F, pvalue = ftest_top$P.Value,
 pvalue_adj = ftest_top$adj.P.Val, stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)
write.csv(ftest_result, OUT_FTEST, row.names = FALSE)
cat(" F-test:", basename(OUT_FTEST), "| Sig:", sum(ftest_result$pvalue_adj <0.05, na.rm=TRUE), "\n\n")

# ===========================================================================
#6. Pairwise LIMMA with VIP
# ===========================================================================
cat("[6/8] Performing pairwise LIMMA + VIP...\n")

GROUP_CD <- "Clostridium difficile infection"
GROUP_FE <- "high iron diet before"
GROUP_NC <- "Standard (control)"

comparisons <- list(
 list(name="FE_vs_CD", t=GROUP_FE, c=GROUP_CD, f=OUT_FE_VS_CD, p="FE_vs_CD",
 title="FE (High-Iron + CDI) vs CD (CDI only)"),
 list(name="CD_vs_NC", t=GROUP_CD, c=GROUP_NC, f=OUT_CD_VS_NC, p="CD_vs_NC",
 title="CD (CDI only) vs NC (Healthy Control)"),
 list(name="FE_vs_NC", t=GROUP_FE, c=GROUP_NC, f=OUT_FE_VS_NC, p="FE_vs_NC",
 title="FE (High-Iron + CDI) vs NC (Healthy Control)")
)

all_de_lists <- list()
all_results <- list()

for (comp in comparisons) {
 comp_name <- comp$name
 cat(" ---", comp_name, "(", comp$t, "vs", comp$c, ") ---\n")
  
 # Subset
 sid <- sample_meta$ID[sample_meta$sample_info %in% c(comp$t, comp$c)]
 ce <- expr_raw[, sid, drop = FALSE]
 cm <- sample_meta[sample_meta$ID %in% sid, , drop = FALSE]
 cm <- cm[match(colnames(ce), cm$ID), ]
 cm$sample_info <- droplevels(cm$sample_info)
  
 cat(" Samples:", ncol(ce), "\n")
  
 # LIMMA
 g <- cm$sample_info
 d <- model.matrix(~0 + g)
 colnames(d) <- make.names(levels(g))
 cstr <- paste0(make.names(comp$t), " - ", make.names(comp$c))
 cmat <- eval(parse(text = paste0("makeContrasts(", cstr, ", levels=d)")))
  
 fit <- lmFit(ce, d)
 fit <- contrasts.fit(fit, cmat)
 fit <- eBayes(fit)
 tt <- topTable(fit, number = Inf, adjust.method = "BH", sort.by = "none")
  
 res <- data.frame(Feature = rownames(tt), logFC = tt$logFC,
 pvalue = tt$P.Value, pvalue_adj = tt$adj.P.Val,
 stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  
 # VIP
 X <- t(ce); Y <- cm$sample_info
 plsda_fit <- mixOmics::plsda(X, Y, ncomp =2, scale=TRUE, center=TRUE)
 vip_m <- mixOmics::vip(plsda_fit)
 vip_v <- vip_m[,1]; names(vip_v) <- rownames(ce)
 res$VIP <- vip_v[res$Feature]
  
 # Filter: p.adj <0.05 -> VIP >1 -> top500 by |logFC|
 sig_p <- res$pvalue_adj <0.05 & !is.na(res$pvalue_adj)
 cat(" After p.adj<0.05:", sum(sig_p), "\n")
 sig_v <- sig_p & !is.na(res$VIP) & res$VIP >1
 cat(" After VIP>1:", sum(sig_v), "\n")
  
 idx <- which(sig_v)
 if (length(idx) >0) {
 idx <- idx[order(-abs(res$logFC[idx]))]
 idx <- idx[1:min(500, length(idx))]
 }
  
 res$significant <- FALSE; res$significant[idx] <- TRUE
 res$direction <- "Not Significant"
 res$direction[res$significant & res$logFC >0] <- "Up"
 res$direction[res$significant & res$logFC <0] <- "Down"
 res$name <- name_map[res$Feature]
 res$class <- class_map[res$Feature]
  
 cat(" Final DE:", sum(res$significant), "(Up:", sum(res$direction=="Up"),
 "Down:", sum(res$direction=="Down"), ")\n")
  
 write.csv(res, comp$f, row.names = FALSE)
 cat(" Saved:", basename(comp$f), "\n\n")
  
 all_results[[comp_name]] <- res
 all_de_lists[[comp_name]] <- res$Feature[res$significant]
}

# Consolidate
cat(" Consolidating results...\n")
consolidated <- data.frame(Feature = rownames(expr_raw),
 name = name_map[rownames(expr_raw)], stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
for (comp in comparisons) {
 r <- all_results[[comp$name]]
 m <- merge(consolidated, r[,c("Feature","logFC","pvalue_adj","VIP","significant","direction")],
 by="Feature", all.x=TRUE)
 colnames(m)[colnames(m)=="logFC"] <- paste0("logFC_",comp$name)
 colnames(m)[colnames(m)=="pvalue_adj"] <- paste0("pval_adj_",comp$name)
 colnames(m)[colnames(m)=="VIP"] <- paste0("VIP_",comp$name)
 colnames(m)[colnames(m)=="significant"] <- paste0("sig_",comp$name)
 colnames(m)[colnames(m)=="direction"] <- paste0("direction_",comp$name)
 consolidated <- m
}
sc <- grep("^sig_", colnames(consolidated))
consolidated$n_significant <- rowSums(consolidated[,sc,drop=FALSE], na.rm=TRUE)
write.csv(consolidated, OUT_CONSOLIDATED, row.names=FALSE)
cat(" Consolidated:", basename(OUT_CONSOLIDATED),
 "| Features sig in >=1 comparison:", sum(consolidated$n_significant>0), "\n\n")

# ===========================================================================
#7. Visualization
# ===========================================================================
cat("[7/8] Generating visualizations...\n")

#7a. Volcano plots
cat(" --- Volcano Plots ---\n")
for (comp in comparisons) {
 res <- all_results[[comp$name]]
 cat(" ", comp$name, "\n")
  
 pd <- res
 pd$neg_log10_p <- -log10(pmax(pd$pvalue_adj,1e-300))
 pd$color_group <- "Not Significant"
 pd$color_group[pd$direction=="Up"] <- "Up"
 pd$color_group[pd$direction=="Down"] <- "Down"
 pd$color_group <- factor(pd$color_group, levels=c("Up","Down","Not Significant"))
  
 # Top5 labels
 sidx <- which(pd$significant)
 if (length(sidx)>0) {
 pd$score <- abs(pd$logFC) * pd$neg_log10_p
 t5 <- sidx[order(-pd$score[sidx])][1:min(5,length(sidx))]
 } else { t5 <- integer(0) }
  
 nu <- sum(pd$direction=="Up", na.rm=TRUE)
 nd <- sum(pd$direction=="Down", na.rm=TRUE)
  
 p <- ggplot(pd, aes(x=logFC, y=neg_log10_p, color=color_group)) +
 geom_point(alpha=0.6, size=1.5) +
 scale_color_manual(values=c(Up="#E64B35", Down="#4DBBD5", "Not Significant"="grey75"),
 labels=c(Up=paste0("Up (", nu,")"), Down=paste0("Down (", nd,")"),
 "Not Significant"=paste0("NS (", sum(!pd$significant),")"))) +
 geom_hline(yintercept=-log10(0.05), linetype="dashed", color="grey50", linewidth=0.5) +
 labs(title=comp$title,
 subtitle=paste0("p.adj<0.05 + VIP>1 | ", sum(pd$significant)," DE metabolites"),
 x=expression(log[2]~Fold~Change),
 y=expression(-log[10]~(adjusted~P~value)), color="Regulation") +
 theme_bw(base_size=12) +
 theme(plot.title=element_text(hjust=0.5,size=14,face="bold"),
 plot.subtitle=element_text(hjust=0.5,size=10,color="grey40"),
 legend.position="right", panel.grid.minor=element_blank())
  
 if (length(t5)>0) {
 p <- p + geom_text_repel(data=pd[t5,], aes(label=name),
 size=3.2, max.overlaps=15, color="black",
 box.padding=0.5, point.padding=0.3, fontface="italic",
 segment.color="grey50", segment.size=0.3)
 }
  
 pf <- file.path(FIGURES_DIR, paste0("Volcano_", comp$p, ".pdf"))
 pn <- file.path(FIGURES_DIR, paste0("Volcano_", comp$p, ".png"))
 pdf(pf, width=9, height=7); print(p); dev.off()
 png(pn, width=2700, height=2100, res=300); print(p); dev.off()
 cat(" Saved\n")
}

#7b. Venn diagram
cat(" --- Venn Diagram ---\n")
vs <- all_de_lists[sapply(all_de_lists, length)>0]
if (length(vs) >=2 && length(vs) <=3) {
 names(vs) <- c(FE_vs_CD="FE vs CD", CD_vs_NC="CD vs NC", FE_vs_NC="FE vs NC")[names(vs)]
  
 pv <- ggVennDiagram(vs, label="count", label_geom="text") +
 scale_fill_gradient(low="white", high="steelblue") +
 labs(title="Differential Metabolites Overlap Across Comparisons") +
 theme_bw() + theme(plot.title=element_text(hjust=0.5,size=14,face="bold"),
 legend.position="none")
  
 pdf(file.path(FIGURES_DIR, "Venn_diagram.pdf"), width=8, height=7); print(pv); dev.off()
 png(file.path(FIGURES_DIR, "Venn_diagram.png"), width=2400, height=2100, res=300); print(pv); dev.off()
 cat(" Saved\n")
} else {
 cat(" Skipped (need2-3 sets). Sizes:", paste(sapply(vs,length), collapse=", "), "\n")
}

#7c. Heatmap
cat(" --- Heatmap ---\n")
asf <- unique(unlist(all_de_lists))
cat(" Unique significant metabolites:", length(asf), "\n")

if (length(asf) >0) {
 hmx <- expr_raw[asf, , drop=FALSE]
 hmz <- t(scale(t(hmx)))
 hmz[is.nan(hmz)] <-0
  
 # Order samples: NC -> CD -> FE
 go <- c(GROUP_NC, GROUP_CD, GROUP_FE)
 so <- unlist(lapply(go, function(g) sample_meta$ID[sample_meta$sample_info==g]))
 so <- intersect(so, colnames(hmz)); hmz <- hmz[, so, drop=FALSE]
  
 ca <- data.frame(Group = factor(sample_meta$sample_info[match(so,sample_meta$ID)], levels=go),
 row.names=so)
  
 gcols <- c("Standard (control)"="#4DBBD5", "Clostridium difficile infection"="#E64B35",
 "high iron diet before"="#00A087")
 ac <- list(Group=gcols)
  
 rc <- class_map[rownames(hmz)]; rc[is.na(rc)] <- "Unknown"
 uc <- unique(rc); nc <- length(uc)
 cp <- if(nc<=12) RColorBrewer::brewer.pal(max(nc,3),"Set3")[1:nc] else rainbow(nc)
 names(cp) <- uc
 ra <- data.frame(Class=factor(rc), row.names=rownames(hmz))
 rac <- list(Class=cp)
  
 rl <- name_map[rownames(hmz)]
 srn <- length(asf) <=100
 fsize <- if(srn)7 else1
  
 hcol <- colorRampPalette(c("#4DBBD5","white","#E64B35"))(100)
 hh <- max(6, min(24, nrow(hmz)*0.25+3))
  
 pdf(file.path(FIGURES_DIR, "Heatmap_diff_metabolites.pdf"), width=10, height=hh)
 pheatmap(hmz, annotation_col=ca, annotation_row=ra,
 annotation_colors=c(ac, rac), cluster_rows=TRUE, cluster_cols=FALSE,
 show_rownames=srn, show_colnames=TRUE, labels_row=rl,
 color=hcol, fontsize_row=fsize, fontsize_col=8,
 border_color=NA, main="Differential Metabolites Heatmap (Z-score)", scale="none")
 dev.off()
  
 png(file.path(FIGURES_DIR, "Heatmap_diff_metabolites.png"), width=3000, height=hh*300, res=300)
 pheatmap(hmz, annotation_col=ca, annotation_row=ra,
 annotation_colors=c(ac, rac), cluster_rows=TRUE, cluster_cols=FALSE,
 show_rownames=srn, show_colnames=TRUE, labels_row=rl,
 color=hcol, fontsize_row=fsize, fontsize_col=8,
 border_color=NA, main="Differential Metabolites Heatmap (Z-score)", scale="none")
 dev.off()
 cat(" Heatmap saved.\n")
} else {
 cat(" No significant metabolites. Skipping heatmap.\n")
}

# ===========================================================================
#8. Summary
# ===========================================================================
cat("\n[8/8] Summary\n")
cat("=================================================================\n")
cat("Module4: LIMMA Differential Analysis - COMPLETED\n")
cat("=================================================================\n")
cat(" Input:", nrow(expr_raw), "metabolites x", ncol(expr_raw), "samples\n")
cat(" Groups:", paste(levels(sample_meta$sample_info), collapse=", "), "\n\n")
cat(" Output files:\n")
cat(" ", basename(OUT_ANOVA), "\n")
cat(" ", basename(OUT_FTEST), "\n")
for (comp in comparisons) {
 cat(" ", basename(comp$f), "(",
 sum(all_results[[comp$name]]$significant, na.rm=TRUE), "DE)\n")
}
cat(" ", basename(OUT_CONSOLIDATED), "\n")
cat("\n Figures:", FIGURES_DIR, "\n")
cat("3 Volcano plots (FE_vs_CD, CD_vs_NC, FE_vs_NC)\n")
cat("1 Venn diagram\n")
cat("1 Heatmap\n")
cat("=================================================================\n")

# =============================================================================
# Module4: LIMMA Differential Analysis
# =============================================================================

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
#0. Configuration
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
WORK_DIR <- "G:/OmicsWorks/test/metabolism/demo/tmp/4_limma_differential_analysis"
TABLES_DIR <- file.path(WORK_DIR, "tables")
FIGURES_DIR <- "G:/OmicsWorks/test/metabolism/demo/analysis/4_limma_differential_analysis/figures"
AGENT_RSCRIPT <- "G:/OmicsWorks/agent/rscript"

PREPROCESSED_EXPR <- "G:/OmicsWorks/test/metabolism/demo/tmp/preprocessed_expression.csv"
SAMPLE_INFO <- "G:/OmicsWorks/test/metabolism/sampleinfo.csv"
DESIGN_JSON <- "G:/OmicsWorks/test/metabolism/demo/analysis/design.json"
METABOLITES_ANNO <- "G:/OmicsWorks/test/metabolism/metabolites.csv"

OUT_ANOVA <- file.path(TABLES_DIR, "limma_multifactor_anova.csv")
OUT_FTEST <- file.path(TABLES_DIR, "limma_overall_ftest.csv")
OUT_FE_VS_CD <- file.path(TABLES_DIR, "limma_FE_vs_CD.csv")
OUT_CD_VS_NC <- file.path(TABLES_DIR, "limma_CD_vs_NC.csv")
OUT_FE_VS_NC <- file.path(TABLES_DIR, "limma_FE_vs_NC.csv")
OUT_CONSOLIDATED <- file.path(TABLES_DIR, "limma_all_comparisons_consolidated.csv")

dir.create(TABLES_DIR, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(FIGURES_DIR, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
#1. Package Installation / Loading
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
cat("=================================================================\n")
cat("Module4: LIMMA Differential Analysis\n")
cat("=================================================================\n\n")
cat("[1/8] Installing/loading required R packages...\n")

cran_pkgs <- c("ggplot2", "ggrepel", "ggVennDiagram", "pheatmap",
 "RColorBrewer", "UpSetR", "jsonlite")
for (pkg in cran_pkgs) {
 if (!requireNamespace(pkg, quietly = TRUE))
 install.packages(pkg, repos = "https://cloud.r-project.org", quiet = TRUE)
 library(pkg, character.only = TRUE)
}

bio_pkgs <- c("limma", "mixOmics")
for (pkg in bio_pkgs) {
 if (!requireNamespace(pkg, quietly = TRUE)) {
 if (!requireNamespace("BiocManager", quietly = TRUE))
 install.packages("BiocManager", repos = "https://cloud.r-project.org", quiet = TRUE)
 BiocManager::install(pkg, ask = FALSE, update = FALSE, quiet = TRUE)
 }
 library(pkg, character.only = TRUE)
}

library(grDevices); library(stats)
cat(" All packages loaded successfully.\n\n")

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
#2. Source helper functions
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
cat("[2/8] Loading helper functions...\n")
source(file.path(AGENT_RSCRIPT, "data_io.R"))
source(file.path(AGENT_RSCRIPT, "differential.R"))
source(file.path(AGENT_RSCRIPT, "multivariate.R"))
source(file.path(AGENT_RSCRIPT, "visualization.R"))
cat(" Helper functions loaded.\n\n")

# ===========================================================================
#3. Data Loading and Validation
# ===========================================================================
cat("[3/8] Loading input data...\n")

expr_raw <- load_expression_matrix(PREPROCESSED_EXPR)
cat(" Expression:", nrow(expr_raw), "x", ncol(expr_raw), "\n")

sample_meta_all <- load_sample_metadata(SAMPLE_INFO)

metab_anno <- read.csv(METABOLITES_ANNO, stringsAsFactors = FALSE, check.names = FALSE)
colnames(metab_anno)[1] <- "ID"
metab_anno$ID <- as.character(metab_anno$ID)

# Match by compound name (expression rownames = compound names)
name_to_anno <- metab_anno[match(rownames(expr_raw), metab_anno$name), , drop = FALSE]
rownames(name_to_anno) <- rownames(expr_raw)
cat(" Annotation match rate:", sum(!is.na(name_to_anno$ID)), "/", nrow(expr_raw), "\n")

name_map <- setNames(name_to_anno$name, rownames(expr_raw))
name_map[is.na(name_map)] <- rownames(expr_raw)[is.na(name_map)]

if ("class" %in% colnames(metab_anno)) {
 class_map <- setNames(name_to_anno$class, rownames(expr_raw))
} else if ("kegg_category" %in% colnames(metab_anno)) {
 class_map <- setNames(name_to_anno$kegg_category, rownames(expr_raw))
} else {
 class_map <- setNames(rep("Unknown", nrow(expr_raw)), rownames(expr_raw))
}
class_map[is.na(class_map)] <- "Unknown"

# Comparison design
design_list <- jsonlite::fromJSON(DESIGN_JSON, simplifyVector = FALSE)
cat(" Comparisons:", length(design_list), "\n")
for (d in design_list) cat(" -", d$name, ":", d$treatment, "vs", d$control, "\n")

# Filter QC, drop unused levels
bio_samples <- intersect(colnames(expr_raw), sample_meta_all$ID)
expr_raw <- expr_raw[, bio_samples, drop = FALSE]
sample_meta <- sample_meta_all[sample_meta_all$ID %in% bio_samples, , drop = FALSE]
sample_meta <- sample_meta[match(colnames(expr_raw), sample_meta$ID), , drop = FALSE]
rownames(sample_meta) <- NULL
sample_meta$sample_info <- droplevels(sample_meta$sample_info)

cat(" Biological samples:", ncol(expr_raw), "\n")
cat(" Groups:", paste(levels(sample_meta$sample_info), collapse = ", "), "\n")
print(table(sample_meta$sample_info))
cat(" Data loading complete.\n\n")

# ===========================================================================
#4. Single-factor ANOVA
# ===========================================================================
cat("[4/8] Performing single-factor ANOVA...\n")

group_vector <- sample_meta$sample_info[match(colnames(expr_raw), sample_meta$ID)]

anova_list <- apply(expr_raw,1, function(row_vals) {
 df <- data.frame(value = as.numeric(row_vals), group = group_vector)
 fit <- aov(value ~ group, data = df)
 s <- summary(fit)[[1]]
 c(F_stat = s$`F value`[1], df_group = s$Df[1], df_resid = s$Df[2], pvalue = s$`Pr(>F)`[1])
})

anova_result <- data.frame(
 Feature = rownames(expr_raw), name = name_map[rownames(expr_raw)],
 F_statistic = anova_list["F_stat", ], Df_group = anova_list["df_group", ],
 Df_residual = anova_list["df_resid", ], pvalue = anova_list["pvalue", ],
 stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)
anova_result$pvalue_adj <- p.adjust(anova_result$pvalue, method = "BH")
write.csv(anova_result, OUT_ANOVA, row.names = FALSE)
cat(" ANOVA:", basename(OUT_ANOVA), "| Sig:", sum(anova_result$pvalue_adj <0.05, na.rm = TRUE), "\n\n")

# ===========================================================================
#5. Overall F-test using limma
# ===========================================================================
cat("[5/8] Performing overall F-test (limma)...\n")

design_all <- model.matrix(~0 + group_vector)
valid_grp_names <- make.names(levels(group_vector))
colnames(design_all) <- valid_grp_names

cat(" Design matrix rank:", qr(design_all)$rank, "vs", ncol(design_all), "\n")

cm_str <- paste0(valid_grp_names[2], " - ", valid_grp_names[1], ",",
 valid_grp_names[3], " - ", valid_grp_names[1])
cm <- eval(parse(text = paste0("makeContrasts(", cm_str, ", levels=design_all)")))

fit_all <- lmFit(expr_raw, design_all)
fit_all <- contrasts.fit(fit_all, cm)
fit_all <- eBayes(fit_all)
ftest_top <- topTable(fit_all, number = Inf, sort.by = "F", adjust.method = "BH")

ftest_result <- data.frame(
 Feature = rownames(ftest_top), name = name_map[rownames(ftest_top)],
 F_statistic = ftest_top$F, pvalue = ftest_top$P.Value,
 pvalue_adj = ftest_top$adj.P.Val, stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)
write.csv(ftest_result, OUT_FTEST, row.names = FALSE)
cat(" F-test:", basename(OUT_FTEST), "| Sig:", sum(ftest_result$pvalue_adj <0.05, na.rm = TRUE), "\n\n")

# ===========================================================================
#6. Pairwise LIMMA with VIP
# ===========================================================================
cat("[6/8] Performing pairwise LIMMA + VIP...\n")

GROUP_CD <- "Clostridium difficile infection"
GROUP_FE <- "high iron diet before"
GROUP_NC <- "Standard (control)"

comparisons <- list(
 list(name = "FE_vs_CD", t = GROUP_FE, c = GROUP_CD, f = OUT_FE_VS_CD, p = "FE_vs_CD",
 title = "FE (High-Iron + CDI) vs CD (CDI only)"),
 list(name = "CD_vs_NC", t = GROUP_CD, c = GROUP_NC, f = OUT_CD_VS_NC, p = "CD_vs_NC",
 title = "CD (CDI only) vs NC (Healthy Control)"),
 list(name = "FE_vs_NC", t = GROUP_FE, c = GROUP_NC, f = OUT_FE_VS_NC, p = "FE_vs_NC",
 title = "FE (High-Iron + CDI) vs NC (Healthy Control)")
)

all_de_lists <- list()
all_results <- list()

for (comp in comparisons) {
 comp_name <- comp$name
 cat(" ---", comp_name, "(", comp$t, "vs", comp$c, ") ---\n")

 # Subset
 sid <- sample_meta$ID[sample_meta$sample_info %in% c(comp$t, comp$c)]
 ce <- expr_raw[, sid, drop = FALSE]
 cm <- sample_meta[sample_meta$ID %in% sid, , drop = FALSE]
 cm <- cm[match(colnames(ce), cm$ID), ]
 cm$sample_info <- droplevels(cm$sample_info)

 cat(" Samples:", ncol(ce), "\n")

 # LIMMA
 g <- cm$sample_info
 d <- model.matrix(~0 + g)
 colnames(d) <- make.names(levels(g))
 cstr <- paste0(make.names(comp$t), " - ", make.names(comp$c))
 cmat <- eval(parse(text = paste0("makeContrasts(", cstr, ", levels=d)")))

 fit <- lmFit(ce, d)
 fit <- contrasts.fit(fit, cmat)
 fit <- eBayes(fit)
 tt <- topTable(fit, number = Inf, adjust.method = "BH", sort.by = "none")

 res <- data.frame(Feature = rownames(tt), logFC = tt$logFC,
 pvalue = tt$P.Value, pvalue_adj = tt$adj.P.Val,
 stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

 # VIP using mixOmics::plsda (note: no 'center' parameter)
 X <- t(ce); Y <- cm$sample_info
 plsda_fit <- mixOmics::plsda(X, Y, ncomp =2, scale = TRUE)
 vip_m <- mixOmics::vip(plsda_fit)
 vip_v <- vip_m[,1]; names(vip_v) <- rownames(ce)
 res$VIP <- vip_v[res$Feature]

 # Filter: p.adj <0.05 -> VIP >1 -> top500 by |logFC|
 sig_p <- res$pvalue_adj <0.05 & !is.na(res$pvalue_adj)
 cat(" After p.adj<0.05:", sum(sig_p), "\n")
 sig_v <- sig_p & !is.na(res$VIP) & res$VIP >1
 cat(" After VIP>1:", sum(sig_v), "\n")

 idx <- which(sig_v)
 if (length(idx) >0) {
 idx <- idx[order(-abs(res$logFC[idx]))]
 idx <- idx[1:min(500, length(idx))]
 }

 res$significant <- FALSE; res$significant[idx] <- TRUE
 res$direction <- "Not Significant"
 res$direction[res$significant & res$logFC >0] <- "Up"
 res$direction[res$significant & res$logFC <0] <- "Down"
 res$name <- name_map[res$Feature]
 res$class <- class_map[res$Feature]

 cat(" Final DE:", sum(res$significant), "(Up:", sum(res$direction == "Up"),
 "Down:", sum(res$direction == "Down"), ")\n")

 write.csv(res, comp$f, row.names = FALSE)
 cat(" Saved:", basename(comp$f), "\n\n")

 all_results[[comp_name]] <- res
 all_de_lists[[comp_name]] <- res$Feature[res$significant]
}

# Consolidate
cat(" Consolidating results...\n")
consolidated <- data.frame(Feature = rownames(expr_raw),
 name = name_map[rownames(expr_raw)], stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
for (comp in comparisons) {
 r <- all_results[[comp$name]]
 m <- merge(consolidated, r[, c("Feature", "logFC", "pvalue_adj", "VIP", "significant", "direction")],
 by = "Feature", all.x = TRUE)
 colnames(m)[colnames(m) == "logFC"] <- paste0("logFC_", comp$name)
 colnames(m)[colnames(m) == "pvalue_adj"] <- paste0("pval_adj_", comp$name)
 colnames(m)[colnames(m) == "VIP"] <- paste0("VIP_", comp$name)
 colnames(m)[colnames(m) == "significant"] <- paste0("sig_", comp$name)
 colnames(m)[colnames(m) == "direction"] <- paste0("direction_", comp$name)
 consolidated <- m
}
sc <- grep("^sig_", colnames(consolidated))
consolidated$n_significant <- rowSums(consolidated[, sc, drop = FALSE], na.rm = TRUE)
write.csv(consolidated, OUT_CONSOLIDATED, row.names = FALSE)
cat(" Consolidated:", basename(OUT_CONSOLIDATED),
 "| Features sig in >=1 comparison:", sum(consolidated$n_significant >0), "\n\n")

# ===========================================================================
#7. Visualization
# ===========================================================================
cat("[7/8] Generating visualizations...\n")

#7a. Volcano plots
cat(" --- Volcano Plots ---\n")
for (comp in comparisons) {
 res <- all_results[[comp$name]]
 cat(" ", comp$name, "\n")

 pd <- res
 pd$neg_log10_p <- -log10(pmax(pd$pvalue_adj,1e-300))
 pd$color_group <- "Not Significant"
 pd$color_group[pd$direction == "Up"] <- "Up"
 pd$color_group[pd$direction == "Down"] <- "Down"
 pd$color_group <- factor(pd$color_group, levels = c("Up", "Down", "Not Significant"))

 # Top5 labels
 sidx <- which(pd$significant)
 if (length(sidx) >0) {
 pd$score <- abs(pd$logFC) * pd$neg_log10_p
 t5 <- sidx[order(-pd$score[sidx])][1:min(5, length(sidx))]
 } else { t5 <- integer(0) }

 nu <- sum(pd$direction == "Up", na.rm = TRUE)
 nd <- sum(pd$direction == "Down", na.rm = TRUE)

 p <- ggplot(pd, aes(x = logFC, y = neg_log10_p, color = color_group)) +
 geom_point(alpha =0.6, size =1.5) +
 scale_color_manual(values = c(Up = "#E64B35", Down = "#4DBBD5", "Not Significant" = "grey75"),
 labels = c(Up = paste0("Up (", nu, ")"), Down = paste0("Down (", nd, ")"),
 "Not Significant" = paste0("NS (", sum(!pd$significant), ")"))) +
 geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(0.05), linetype = "dashed", color = "grey50", linewidth =0.5) +
 labs(title = comp$title,
 subtitle = paste0("p.adj<0.05 + VIP>1 | ", sum(pd$significant), " DE metabolites"),
 x = expression(log[2]~Fold~Change),
 y = expression(-log[10]~(adjusted~P~value)), color = "Regulation") +
 theme_bw(base_size =12) +
 theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust =0.5, size =14, face = "bold"),
 plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust =0.5, size =10, color = "grey40"),
 legend.position = "right", panel.grid.minor = element_blank())

 if (length(t5) >0) {
 p <- p + geom_text_repel(data = pd[t5, ], aes(label = name),
 size =3.2, max.overlaps =15, color = "black",
 box.padding =0.5, point.padding =0.3, fontface = "italic",
 segment.color = "grey50", segment.size =0.3)
 }

 pf <- file.path(FIGURES_DIR, paste0("Volcano_", comp$p, ".pdf"))
 pn <- file.path(FIGURES_DIR, paste0("Volcano_", comp$p, ".png"))
 pdf(pf, width =9, height =7); print(p); dev.off()
 png(pn, width =2700, height =2100, res =300); print(p); dev.off()
 cat(" Saved\n")
}

#7b. Venn diagram
cat(" --- Venn Diagram ---\n")
vs <- all_de_lists[sapply(all_de_lists, length) >0]
if (length(vs) >=2 && length(vs) <=3) {
 names(vs) <- c(FE_vs_CD = "FE vs CD", CD_vs_NC = "CD vs NC", FE_vs_NC = "FE vs NC")[names(vs)]

 pv <- ggVennDiagram(vs, label = "count", label_geom = "text") +
 scale_fill_gradient(low = "white", high = "steelblue") +
 labs(title = "Differential Metabolites Overlap Across Comparisons") +
 theme_bw() + theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust =0.5, size =14, face = "bold"),
 legend.position = "none")

 pdf(file.path(FIGURES_DIR, "Venn_diagram.pdf"), width =8, height =7); print(pv); dev.off()
 png(file.path(FIGURES_DIR, "Venn_diagram.png"), width =2400, height =2100, res =300); print(pv); dev.off()
 cat(" Saved\n")
} else {
 cat(" Skipped (need2-3 sets). Sizes:", paste(sapply(vs, length), collapse = ", "), "\n")
}

#7c. Heatmap
cat(" --- Heatmap ---\n")
asf <- unique(unlist(all_de_lists))
cat(" Unique significant metabolites:", length(asf), "\n")

if (length(asf) >0) {
 hmx <- expr_raw[asf, , drop = FALSE]
 hmz <- t(scale(t(hmx)))
 hmz[is.nan(hmz)] <-0

 # Order samples: NC -> CD -> FE
 go <- c(GROUP_NC, GROUP_CD, GROUP_FE)
 so <- unlist(lapply(go, function(g) sample_meta$ID[sample_meta$sample_info == g]))
 so <- intersect(so, colnames(hmz)); hmz <- hmz[, so, drop = FALSE]

 ca <- data.frame(Group = factor(sample_meta$sample_info[match(so, sample_meta$ID)], levels = go),
 row.names = so)

 gcols <- c("Standard (control)" = "#4DBBD5", "Clostridium difficile infection" = "#E64B35",
 "high iron diet before" = "#00A087")
 ac <- list(Group = gcols)

 rc <- class_map[rownames(hmz)]; rc[is.na(rc)] <- "Unknown"
 uc <- unique(rc); nc <- length(uc)
 cp <- if (nc <=12) RColorBrewer::brewer.pal(max(nc,3), "Set3")[1:nc] else rainbow(nc)
 names(cp) <- uc
 ra <- data.frame(Class = factor(rc), row.names = rownames(hmz))
 rac <- list(Class = cp)

 rl <- name_map[rownames(hmz)]
 srn <- length(asf) <=100
 fsize <- if (srn)7 else1

 hcol <- colorRampPalette(c("#4DBBD5", "white", "#E64B35"))(100)
 hh <- max(6, min(24, nrow(hmz) *0.25 +3))

 pdf(file.path(FIGURES_DIR, "Heatmap_diff_metabolites.pdf"), width =10, height = hh)
 pheatmap(hmz, annotation_col = ca, annotation_row = ra,
 annotation_colors = c(ac, rac), cluster_rows = TRUE, cluster_cols = FALSE,
 show_rownames = srn, show_colnames = TRUE, labels_row = rl,
 color = hcol, fontsize_row = fsize, fontsize_col =8,
 border_color = NA, main = "Differential Metabolites Heatmap (Z-score)", scale = "none")
 dev.off()

 png(file.path(FIGURES_DIR, "Heatmap_diff_metabolites.png"), width =3000, height = hh *300, res =300)
 pheatmap(hmz, annotation_col = ca, annotation_row = ra,
 annotation_colors = c(ac, rac), cluster_rows = TRUE, cluster_cols = FALSE,
 show_rownames = srn, show_colnames = TRUE, labels_row = rl,
 color = hcol, fontsize_row = fsize, fontsize_col =8,
 border_color = NA, main = "Differential Metabolites Heatmap (Z-score)", scale = "none")
 dev.off()
 cat(" Heatmap saved.\n")
} else {
 cat(" No significant metabolites. Skipping heatmap.\n")
}

# ===========================================================================
#8. Summary
# ===========================================================================
cat("\n[8/8] Summary\n")
cat("=================================================================\n")
cat("Module4: LIMMA Differential Analysis - COMPLETED\n")
cat("=================================================================\n")
cat(" Input:", nrow(expr_raw), "metabolites x", ncol(expr_raw), "samples\n")
cat(" Groups:", paste(levels(sample_meta$sample_info), collapse = ", "), "\n\n")
cat(" Output files:\n")
cat(" ", basename(OUT_ANOVA), "\n")
cat(" ", basename(OUT_FTEST), "\n")
for (comp in comparisons) {
 cat(" ", basename(comp$f), "(",
 sum(all_results[[comp$name]]$significant, na.rm = TRUE), "DE)\n")
}
cat(" ", basename(OUT_CONSOLIDATED), "\n")
cat("\n Figures:", FIGURES_DIR, "\n")
cat("3 Volcano plots (FE_vs_CD, CD_vs_NC, FE_vs_NC)\n")
cat("1 Venn diagram\n")
cat("1 Heatmap\n")
cat("=================================================================\n")

# 研究主题
我正在探讨高铁饮食对感染艰难梭菌小鼠的肠道免疫反应、肠道菌群及代谢的影响，并揭示特定的肠道菌群及其代谢物在艰难梭菌感染（CDI）中的具体作用机制。研究希望阐明“饮食-肠道菌群-宿主”之间的相互作用是如何调节宿主对CDI的易感性及疾病严重程度的。研究主要通过以下几个步骤和实验方法展开：

构建动物模型与表型分析：
构建了小鼠艰难梭菌感染（CDI）模型，并将其分为接受高铁饮食（含400 mg/kg硫酸亚铁）处理组和对照组。
观察发现高铁饮食能够减轻CDI，其机制与降低艰难梭菌的致病性以及改变宿主肠道中性粒细胞的招募有关。

在我的样本分组中，high iron diet before为在感染前进行了高铁饮食干预的病原菌感染实验组，Standard (control)则是什么也没有感染的健康小鼠对照样本，Clostridium difficile infection则是什么也没做处理的感染病原菌的处理组。QC组的样本是用于评估实验数据采集稳定性的QC组样本

# 上游模块总结
## 模块 1: Expression Matrix Preprocessing
##模块一：表达矩阵预处理 —阶段性总结###一、数据预处理整体概况本研究使用的代谢组学表达矩阵包含 **2,059个代谢物分子**和 **18个生物学样本**，分别来自三个实验分组：**CD组**（艰难梭菌感染组，Fc16YH_CD1~CD6，n=6）、**FE组**（感染前高铁饮食干预组，Fc16YH_FE1~FE6，n=6）和**NC组**（健康对照，Fc16YH_NC1~NC6，n=6）。样本信息表中还包含3个QC质控样本（Fc16YH_QC01~QC03），但QC样本未出现在表达矩阵中，仅用于实验数据采集稳定性的评估，不参与后续生物学分析。

原始表达矩阵的代谢物丰度值范围极宽，从 **0.0095到283.38**，均值为1.50，标准差高达3.66，反映出代谢组学数据固有的动态范围大和不同代谢物间量级差异悬殊的特点。数据中**未检测到缺失值（NA）**，数据完整性良好。

###二、各预处理步骤参数与结果整个预处理流程严格按照标准代谢组学数据处理规范，按以下四个步骤依次执行：

**1.缺失值填充（half-minimum策略）**
按行（每个代谢物）检测缺失值，对该行所有非缺失正值取最小值的一半作为填充值。由于原始数据不存在缺失值，该步骤未实际修改数据矩阵，但作为质控环节保留执行。

**2.列总和归一化（相对丰度，ppm）**
对每个样本的代谢物表达值求和，将每个值除以该样本总和后乘以缩放因子 **1×10⁶**，转换为百万分之一（ppm）单位的相对丰度。归一化前，各样本的列总和波动在 **2,565.7 ~3,691.8**之间（标准差369.84），说明不同样本间的总离子强度存在显著差异——这主要来源于样本制备、仪器灵敏度等系统误差而非生物学差异。归一化后，所有样本的列总和稳定在 **999,610 ~999,729 ppm**（标准差仅37.89），系统技术变异被有效消除，代谢物表达值范围变为 **2.59 ~84,110.52 ppm**。

**3. log2(x+1)转换**
归一化后数据最大值（84,110.52）远超阈值100，确认数据未经过对数转换。因此采用 log₂(x+1)对数据进行转换，将表达值范围压缩至 **1.85 ~16.36**，均值降至8.45。对数转换使数据分布从高度右偏变为近似正态分布，满足后续差异分析和聚类分析对数据正态性的要求，同时稳定了低丰度代谢物的方差。

**4.中位数缩放**
按行（每个代谢物）计算其中位数，然后将该代谢物在所有样本中的表达值除以其自身的中位数。经过此步骤，**全部2,059个代谢物的中位数均精确为1.0**，数据整体范围缩小至 **0.217 ~2.365**，均值为1.025，标准差进一步降至0.127。中位数缩放消除了不同代谢物间绝对丰度的量级差异，使低丰度与高丰度代谢物的相对变化具有可比性，适合后续热图可视化和聚类分析。

###三、数据分布变化总结经过完整的四步预处理，数据分布发生了显著变化：

|指标 |原始数据 |列和归一化(ppm) | log2(x+1) |中位数缩放 |
|:---|:---:|:---:|:---:|:---:|
|最小值 |0.0095 |2.59 |1.85 |0.217 |
|最大值 |283.38 |84,110.52 |16.36 |2.365 |
|均值 |1.50 |485.51 |8.45 |1.025 |
|中位数 |0.97 | — | — | **1.000** |
|标准差 |3.66 | — | — |0.127 |

数据从原始高度右偏的分布形态，通过log2转换变为近似对称分布，再经中位数缩放将所有代谢物对齐到共同的参照水平（中位数=1），使得不同代谢物之间的比较不再受绝对丰度量级的影响。最终预处理数据中，各分组的组均值分别为 CD组=1.037、FE组=1.005、NC组=1.033，三组在缩放后均围绕1.0波动，保留了生物学差异的信息。

###四、数据质量评估从质量评估角度看，该代谢组学数据集具有以下优点：
1. **数据完整性良好**：无缺失值，避免了因缺失数据导致的偏差和样本丢失；
2. **无负值**：所有表达值均为正数，符合代谢组学质谱数据特征；
3. **QC设计完善**：存在独立的QC样本（虽未纳入表达矩阵），可用于评估实验过程中的技术稳定性；
4. **分组生物学重复充足**：每个实验分组均有6个独立生物学重复，为后续统计分析提供了足够的统计效力。

###五、与研究主题的关联性本研究旨在探讨"**高铁饮食 →肠道菌群失调 → CDI易感性改变 →代谢物介导**"这一链条中的分子机制。预处理后的表达矩阵保留了三组之间真实的代谢物丰度差异信息：

- **CD组 vs NC组**：揭示艰难梭菌感染引起的肠道代谢物谱变化，包括胆汁酸代谢紊乱、SCFA减少、铁载体相关代谢物升高等预期特征；
- **FE组 vs CD组**：明确高铁饮食干预对感染状态下代谢组的调节作用，特别是铁稳态相关代谢物（血红素、铁载体、转铁蛋白）、胆汁酸、短链脂肪酸等关键代谢物的差异；
- **FE组 vs NC组**：评估高铁饮食本身对正常肠道代谢的影响。

最终输出的标准化表达矩阵（`preprocessed_expression.csv`）已传递至下游模块，将依次用于 **PCA降维与离群检测（模块2）、LIMMA差异分析（模块4）、WGCNA共表达网络分析（模块6）和CMeans聚类分析（模块7）**，为揭示高铁饮食调节CDI易感性的代谢物基础和分子机制奠定数据基础。

## 模块 3: Comparison Group Design
##模块三：比对组设计 —阶段性总结###一、整体设计思路本研究基于代谢组学表达矩阵（2,059个代谢物 ×18个生物学样本），从样本信息表中识别出三个可用生物学分组：**NC组**（健康对照，n=6）、**CD组**（艰难梭菌感染，n=6）和**FE组**（感染前高铁饮食干预，n=6）。3个QC质控样本仅用于技术稳定性评估，不参与生物学分析。

围绕"高铁饮食如何调节CDI易感性"这一核心科学问题，我们设计了**3组两两比对**，形成层次化的比对策略：以 **FE_vs_CD**为一级核心比对（直接回答高铁饮食对CDI代谢组的影响），**CD_vs_NC**为二级模型验证（建立CDI感染基线代谢特征），**FE_vs_NC**为三级整体效应评估（衡量高铁饮食+CDI的综合扰动）。三组比对相互印证，构成从"感染基线 →饮食干预效应 →综合扰动"的完整证据链。

###二、各组比对的生物学依据与预期发现**1. FE_vs_CD（核心比对，优先级最高）**

FE组与CD组均感染了艰难梭菌，唯一变量为FE组在感染前接受了400 mg/kg硫酸亚铁的高铁饮食。此比对的生物学意义在于：知识库明确揭示高铁饮食可通过增加肠道内铁浓度，经FeoAB/Fhu/Fur铁摄取系统直接促进C. difficile生长（体外Fe³⁺100 μM时CFU增13.8倍），上调tcdA/tcdB毒素表达（毒素A蛋白增8.6倍），同时改变宿主营养免疫（calprotectin释放增强、lipocalin-2介导的铁载体螯合）和胆汁酸代谢（结合型胆汁酸升高促进孢子萌发）。预期FE组铁稳态代谢物（血红素、enterobactin等铁载体）显著上调，结合型胆汁酸（牛磺胆酸盐TCA）升高而抑制孢子萌发的胆酸盐降低，短链脂肪酸（尤其丁酸）显著降低。

**2. CD_vs_NC（模型验证比对）**

此比对建立CDI感染本身的代谢组特征基线。根据知识库，CDI感染会引起肠道菌群失调（肠杆菌科富集、产SCFA菌减少）、胆汁酸代谢紊乱（结合型胆汁酸升高促进孢子萌发）、宿主营养免疫应答（calprotectin和lipocalin-2上调）及炎症反应（中性粒细胞浸润、TNFα/IL-1β释放）。预期观察到胆汁酸谱典型偏移、SCFA水平下降、炎症相关代谢物升高等感染特征。该比对既是模型验证手段，也是区分"CDI本身效应"与"高铁饮食叠加效应"的基准参照。

**3. FE_vs_NC（整体效应比对）**

评估高铁饮食联合CDI感染相对于健康基线的综合代谢扰动幅度。与CD_vs_NC比较，可区分哪些变化是CDI本身引起，哪些是高铁饮食的叠加/协同效应。预期FE_vs_NC的扰动幅度大于CD_vs_NC，尤其在铁代谢物、胆汁酸紊乱和SCFA降低方面更为显著，并可能观察到铁毒性相关的氧化应激代谢物（谷胱甘肽代谢物、脂质过氧化物）升高。

###三、与研究主题的深度关联性比对设计精准对应研究主题中"饮食-肠道菌群-宿主"互作链条的每个环节：**高铁饮食**（FE_vs_CD的核心变量）→ **肠道菌群失调**（通过SCFA、胆汁酸、腐败代谢物反映）→ **CDI易感性改变**（通过铁载体、毒素相关代谢物、营养免疫标志物反映）→ **代谢物介导机制**（通过胆汁酸谱、铁稳态代谢物、氧化应激标志物揭示）。比对设计系统覆盖了知识库中记载的24条关键通路和19类关键代谢物。

###四、设计合理性论证- **分层递进**：三组比对从"有无高铁饮食的影响"（FE_vs_CD）到"有无感染的影响"（CD_vs_NC）再到"综合效应"（FE_vs_NC），形成完整的逻辑闭环。
- **统计效力充分**：每组均有6个独立生物学重复，满足LIMMA分析要求。
- **分组命名精准对应样本信息表**，确保了后续模块可直接调用，无需额外数据清洗。
- **横截面设计与本模块匹配**：数据集为单一时间点采样，无需时间序列比对。
